gloss: fine article; excellent product; quality piece

definitions.gloss: fine article; excellent product; quality piece
definitions.explanation: An item of notably good quality, whether a piece of art, a literary work, or a well-crafted product.

examples.japanese: この{陶器|とうき}は{佳品|かひん}として{知|し}られている。
examples.english: This ceramic piece is known as a fine article.

examples.japanese: {展覧会|てんらんかい}には{多|おお}くの{佳品|かひん}が{並|なら}んでいた。
examples.english: Many fine works were displayed at the exhibition.

examples.japanese: {地元|じもと}の{職人|しょくにん}が{手|て}がけた{佳品|かひん}の{数々|かずかず}が{贈答用|ぞうとうよう}としても{喜|よろこ}ばれている。
examples.english: The many fine articles crafted by local artisans are also well received as gifts.

notes:
A compound of {佳|か} (good, beautiful, fine) and {品|ひん} (article, item). A literary and somewhat formal word. While {佳|か} can describe beauty in a general sense, {佳品|かひん} specifically emphasizes quality craftsmanship or artistic merit rather than just aesthetic appeal.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {佳品|かひん}を{集|あつ}める: to collect fine articles
- {佳品|かひん}が{並|なら}ぶ: fine pieces are lined up
- {知|し}る{人|ひと}ぞ{知|し}る{佳品|かひん}: a fine article known to connoisseurs

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {名品|めいひん}: masterpiece; famous article — implies wider recognition and higher prestige
- {逸品|いっぴん}: gem; outstanding item — stronger praise, suggesting something exceptional
- {良品|りょうひん}: quality goods — more commercial, emphasizing reliable quality over artistic merit
